synthesis.headline: Not cost-bound and not proven edge-less: in the era you are actually trading, gross profit is indistinguishable from zero, the cost is certain (~45-50 bps, ~$0.30 per round trip), no instrument you own can find a directional signal, and the model is not even the thing placing the trades. The pooled '+$4.45 gross, fees 5.4x it' number is uncitable. Wait for the registered era-9 readout, and build the instrument that readout requires first, because it does not exist yet.
synthesis.the_diagnosis: Neither label fits, and the one you were handed ('COST-BOUND: a real edge that fees eat') rests on a number your own law forbids. THE MONEY (re-derived 2026-09-15T04:27Z from outputs/fills.csv, 1,322 legs, and outputs/status.json): the '+$4.45 gross before fees' is status.json's ledger POOLED across six fee/configuration eras (exec_era stamps 7,8,9,10,11,12) since the 2026-08-10 capital reset. Split by era, that +$4.45 is one retired configuration - era-7 (Aug 12-28, hedged 12-asset book, 59 trips, gross +$8.48, net +$1.21, gross/trip CI [-$0.01,+$0.29], touching zero) - plus everything since roughly cancelling. The era accruing NOW (12-10d4d0c2, first fill 2026-09-09T21:35Z): 22 trips wholly inside the era (27 if you count 5 straddlers that opened under earlier fee rows, and one of those 27 is a double-written exit), gross about -$3 to -$4, fees $8.25, net about -$11; gross per trip mean -$0.11, 95% CI [-$0.52,+$0.29], median +$0.10, 13/26 winners, overlap-deflated effective n about 6. That sign cannot be resolved at n=22 against a registered lean of n=50. So 'fees are eating a real edge' is unproven AND 'the entry has negative gross' is equally unproven. THE COST is the only certain line: every exit (28/28) booked at 30 bps taker, entries 26 maker / 6 taker, blended 48.6-50 bps per round trip, $0.30/trip, about $1.2-1.6/day of paper - which is exactly the H0 (-$0.27/trip) the n=100 gate was registered against. THE SIGNAL: five independent instruments agree. The deployed gbt scores slightly WORSE than always-predicting-the-base-rate (Brier 0.2515 vs 0.2437 on 15,805 out-of-sample rows; day-block CI on the difference [-0.0086,+0.0216], so 'probably worse, not proven'); the learning curve is flat (AUC moved 0.023 from 4,739 to 18,956 rows); RESOLUTION AUC 0.616 but DIRECTION AUC 0.510 with 0 of 7 pairs significant; holding day and side fixed, out-of-sample direction AUC is 0.515 [0.433,0.605] under boosted stumps and 0.495 [0.451,0.540] under logistic; the deployed model file's own walk-forward importance has 'direction' absent from its top ten. The apparent 21-point long-vs-short win gap (52% vs 31%) is the day's realized market move, flips sign on 15 of 35 days, and REVERSES inside the era-9 window (shorts 54%, longs 37%). AND THE MODEL IS NOT DECIDING: 23 of 23 era-9 five-minute-book entries were exploration probes (ML-070) admitted by a model-free budget roll and sized on a forced p=0.85 while the model said 0.39-0.51; zero conviction entries since the cut. So the money is paying a certain ~45 bps per trip to place what are, informationally, coin flips, on a ledger too small to prove it either way. Where the lanes disagreed: money-truth called era-9 gross 'negative, decisive'; both reviewing lenses demoted it to 'undetermined' (CI spans zero, n below the registered lean). Trust the demotion - it is the pre-registered standard, and reading accruing numbers as a verdict is the exact error CLAUDE.md forbids. Deciding numbers: era-9 gross/trip -$0.11 +/- $0.21 SE; fee/trip $0.30; direction AUC 0.495-0.515 with CIs spanning 0.5; probes 23/23.
what_is_actually_working: Fee booking and era segmentation reproduce to the cent by two independent routes (trip reconstruction vs leg-level sum): era-9 fees $8.25, exits 28/28 at exactly 30.00 bps, entries 26 at exactly 15.00 / 6 at exactly 30.00 (fills.csv as of 2026-09-15T04:27Z). The record is honest inside a segment.

The profit-target maker-first exit rung fires as designed (main.py:2552; both era-9 tb_pt exits rested post-only first, expired unfilled at the 25 s TTL, escalated). Risk-off exits are marketable-first by design (invariant 5). Nothing here is broken; it just captured $0.

Scope: of 188,786 tracked Python lines only 49,902 ship; 92,639 are tests and 46,158 are tools. The money path is ~36 files / ~32k lines plus config.json (956 leaf keys). HANDOFF:1055 (2026-09-06) already says 'per-era gross is a table, not a number'.

The entry stream carries no detectable directional information at the 36 h horizon (five instruments, above), and the deployed model is not selecting era-9 trades anyway (23/23 probes at forced p=0.85). Model-side work is FROZEN (2026-08-10) and would be pointed at the wrong component regardless.

The cut-#11 registration (docs/quant/2026-09-07_cut11_commit_adjudication.md:86-99, adopted for era-9 by CLAUDE.md:158-161) names net $/trip with a 95% day-block bootstrap CI (UTC day of closing fill, 4,000 reps, seed 7), n=50 lean (act only if CI excludes zero), n=100 verdict (CONTINUE iff net>0 with CI excluding -fee). scripts/cohort_eval.py has one threshold (n=50, :144), no n=100 tier, no interval anywhere in its decision (:387-394 branches on point-estimate signs), a naive iid SE on nominal n (:378-379), measures %/trip not $/trip, and runs its verdict on the POOLED n=131 era-4 population while printing only a count for era-9. No script in the repo performs the registered test.

The gross - the thing that would have to pay that cost - is indistinguishable from zero in the era you are trading (mean -$0.11/trip, CI [-$0.52,+$0.29], effective n about 6) and was only marginal in the one retired configuration that looked good (era-7, CI touching zero). Five independent instruments find no directional information in the entry stream (direction AUC 0.495-0.515 with CIs spanning 0.5, flat learning curve, deployed model's own walk-forward importance dropping 'direction'), and the model is not even choosing the trades - 23 of 23 era-9 entries were exploration probes admitted by a budget roll and sized at a forced 85% win probability. So this is not 'a real but tiny edge eaten by fees' - even at zero fees the expected net is about zero - and the fee levers, which are all cohort-resetting anyway, recover at most a few cents per trade. The registered n=100 verdict should be expected to land on STOP by either branch (no-gross-edge or cost-bound both route to STOP under the era-9 registration), and STOP does not mean going back to the hedged 12-asset book, which is the measured loss channel. Real dollars at risk today: zero - this is a paper account behind four locks. What is being spent is calendar time and the meaning of the one experiment running; protect that, do not spend it on fee work. If the readout comes back CONTINUE, suspect the instrument before the market: that is what the record keeps vindicating.
